description: These frozen dataclasses represent Mini expressions after parsing.

steps.description: The module imports annotations and dataclasses. Node, Expr, and Stmt mark the AST categories.
Num, Str, Bool, and Nil represent literal expressions.
Var holds a name. BinOp holds an operator with left and right expression children.
UnaryOp stores one operand. Call stores a callee and its argument tuple.
Lambda stores parameter names and a body. LetIn records a name, value, and body for internal use.

title: Define expression AST nodes
